veranderings.rede: The nearest antecedent is 'sulke werk', so 'hulle' has no clear referent; naming the workers fixes the reference at the cost of one word.
'maak nie 'n ding nie' is wooden; 'nie iets nie' is the natural form and matches the glossary definition of diens, with no change in word count.
A place where cars and machines are repaired is idiomatically a 'werkplaas'; 'werkswinkel' leans on English 'workshop' and also means a seminar.
'ry' can be read as riding as a passenger; 'bestuur' makes clear this is the driver's job, with no change in word count.
